status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

combinationProbabilities.wide: unordered inclusion of both horses in top3 under Plackett-Luce

marketProbability: inverse JRA official ticket odds normalized to probability mass 3 for wide and 1 for every single-winning-ticket market
ticketScore: blended combination probability * JRA official odds

blendSelector.metric: Bayesian-shrunk realized return of top 10 tickets on strictly prior dates only

raceSelection.selector: one expanding LightGBM Huber virtual-return model per course using strictly prior dates only
raceSelection.coldStart: mean top-three fixed ticket scores across course-required bet types

allocation: mandatory 100 yen on the top ticket of every required bet type, then allocate remaining 100-yen units by ticket score times prior-date shrunk blend return, respecting each course single-ticket cap and fully spending the exact course budget
settlement: actual fixed-archive JRA payout rows only
